text: This report recommends that City Council approve the alterations proposed for the property at 8 Lowther Avenue under Part 5, Section 42 of the Ontario Heritage Act in connection with the construction of a roof top addition with roof deck. The subject property is located on the north side of Lowther Avenue between Bedford Road and Avenue Road and contains a three-storey semi-detached building with brick and stone cladding. The subject lands are part of the East Annex Heritage Conservation District. The development proposal includes a new roof addition with roof deck on top of the existing third storey. The new addition is higher than the ridge of the existing heritage building and would therefore not comply with the guidelines for additions in the East Annex Heritage Conservation District Plan which state that additions should be lower than the height of the existing ridge. City Council on July 29 and 30, 2026, adopted the following: 1. City Council approve the construction of the roof addition and alterations at the heritage property at 8 Lowther Avenue, in accordance with Section 42 of the Ontario Heritage Act, with such alterations substantially in accordance with plans and drawings prepared by Joseph Cohen, dated May 20, 2026, and on file with the Senior Manager, Heritage Planning, and to the satisfaction of the Senior Manager, Heritage Planning.
